sources.binary: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-421 and BD-14 1137B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 2984582227215748864 and 2984582227215748224), 2,206 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 1.1e-4: the pair is bound.
